candidates.text: System is allowing to cancel Buyer Order GDN after Sales Invoice is created
We need to implement a restriction so that once a Sales Invoice has been created, the Buyer Order Dispatch transaction cannot be cancelled.

Once a Sales Invoice has been created against a Buyer Order Dispatch (GDN), the system should not allow cancellation of the Buyer Order Dispatch, If the Sales Invoice has been confirmed or Posted status, Else Cancel status can be Allowed.
Additionally, when the user attempts to cancel the GDN, the system should display an alert message listing the respective Sales Invoice(s) created against that transaction.

chunks.title: Business Requirement
chunks.heading: Business Requirement
chunks.text: The user has cancelled the Buyer Order Dispatch transaction after creating the Sales Invoice, due to which the stock is showing incorrectly in the system. We need to implement a restriction so that once a Sales Invoice has been created, the Buyer Order Dispatch transaction cannot be cancelled.
